title: A 5xx head before any forwarded byte is retried, then the caller sees only the 200 stream
notes: Retry happens on the 429/5xx HEAD, before the head is forwarded, and only for a replay-safe model endpoint (a POST to a configured standard model endpoint; an ordinary egress POST is single-shot). The 58-byte length is the exact length of the error body above. delays_ms is the configured schedule with jitterFraction 0; the production default jitters each delay into [0.8x, 1x], so a runner must compare the attempt count, not the exact delay, unless it also disables jitter. A 429 with Retry-After wins over the exponential schedule (ModelGatewayTests:900-916).
